notes: Every train accepts a Suica card, and Google Maps is flawless for train times. A JR Pass is unnecessary within Tokyo; for Nikko, get the Tobu pass.
Summer brings 33°C heat and humidity, plus festivals and fireworks (hanabi) in July and August. Go out early in the morning and choose indoor venues in the afternoon.
Cash still matters, especially at small ramen shops. 7-Eleven ATMs accept foreign cards. There is no tipping.
Be quiet in temples and do not take photos inside. Do not talk on the phone on the metro, and do not eat while walking.
Book Shibuya Sky and teamLab tickets weeks ahead. Visit Tsukiji before 10:00.
Ramen costs 1,000-1,500 JPY, a konbini (convenience store) breakfast 500 JPY, and a sushi counter 3,000+.

transit.name: Suica / Welcome Suica
transit.why_chosen: Works on JR, metro, buses and at konbini (convenience stores), and can be added to your phone
transit.coverage: Tokyo'daki tüm tren ve metro hatları, otobüsler, marketler
transit.where_to_buy: Havalimanı ve JR istasyonları; iPhone Wallet

stops.name: Senso-ji
stops.tips: Tokyo's oldest temple. See the Kaminarimon lantern, and come at 08:00 when Nakamise is empty. Draw an omikuji fortune.

stops.name: Nakamise Dori
stops.tips: Shops lining the temple approach. Try ningyo-yaki (small sponge cakes) and senbei (rice crackers).

stops.name: Asakusa Kappabashi
stops.tips: Kitchenware street. Look for Japanese knives and plastic food models.

stops.name: Asakusa Unatoto
stops.tips: Cheap unagi (eel) donburi. The queue is short.

stops.name: Tokyo Skytree
stops.tips: 634 m tall. Book Tembo Deck tickets online, go in the afternoon for clear skies, and walk over the Sumida River.

backups.name: Asakusa Imahan
backups.tips: Sukiyaki since 1895. Go for the special lunch.

backups.name: Sumida River Cruise
backups.tips: Water bus from Asakusa to Odaiba. Take it instead of Skytree.

stops.name: Meiji Jingu
stops.tips: Shinto shrine in the forest. See the sake barrels. It is calm in the morning, and wedding processions pass on weekends.

stops.name: Takeshita Street
stops.tips: Harajuku youth fashion. Crepe stalls line the street, and it gets packed after 11:00.

stops.name: Omotesando
stops.tips: Tokyo's Champs-Élysées. Come for the architecture and the mirrored entrance of Tokyu Plaza.

stops.name: Afuri Ramen Harajuku
stops.tips: Yuzu shio ramen. Order from the ticket machine.

stops.name: Shibuya Sky
stops.tips: Open-air terrace above the Shibuya Scramble. Book the sunset slot online weeks ahead, and watch the crossing from above.

backups.name: Ichiran Shibuya
backups.tips: Tonkotsu ramen in single-person booths. Open 24 hours.

backups.name: Yoyogi Park
backups.tips: Park next to Meiji Jingu. Rockabilly dancers perform on weekends.

stops.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
stops.tips: Morning stalls serve tamago (sweet omelette), uni and tuna. Go before 10:00 and eat standing up.

stops.name: Hamarikyu Gardens
stops.tips: Edo-period garden among the skyscrapers. Have matcha in the tea house.

stops.name: Ginza Chuo Dori
stops.tips: Closed to traffic on weekends. Visit the Itoya stationery store and the 12-floor Uniqlo.

stops.name: Ginza Kagari Ramen
stops.tips: Chicken paitan ramen. It is a small counter, so expect a queue.

stops.name: teamLab Planets
stops.tips: Digital art museum where you wade through water. Book online weeks ahead and wear shorts (the water is knee-deep).

backups.name: Sushi Dai Toyosu
backups.tips: Legendary sushi at Toyosu Market. The queue starts at 05:00.

backups.name: Ginza Six Rooftop Garden
backups.tips: Shopping mall rooftop. Go here if you have no teamLab ticket.

stops.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building
stops.tips: Free observation deck on the 45th floor. Mount Fuji is visible in clear weather.

stops.name: Shinjuku Gyoen
stops.tips: Japanese, English and French gardens. Best in sakura and momiji (autumn leaf) season.

stops.name: Fuunji Shinjuku
stops.tips: Tsukemen (dipping ramen) legend. Expect a 20-minute queue.

stops.name: Yanaka Ginza
stops.tips: Old Tokyo (shitamachi) shopping street. Look for cats and menchi katsu (fried minced meat cutlet), and visit Yanaka Cemetery.

stops.name: Omoide Yokocho
stops.tips: Izakaya alley in Shinjuku. Yakitori and beer, nicknamed 'Piss Alley'.

backups.name: Golden Gai
backups.tips: Neighbourhood of tiny bars. Ask about the cover charge.

backups.name: Nezu Shrine
backups.tips: Tunnel of red torii gates near Yanaka. Azaleas bloom in April.

stops.name: Ueno Park
stops.tips: Park of museums. It is the heart of Tokyo in sakura season.

stops.name: Tokyo National Museum
stops.tips: Japan's largest museum. See samurai armour and ukiyo-e prints.

stops.name: Ameyoko Market
stops.tips: Market beneath the Ueno tracks. Street food and dried fruit.

stops.name: Akihabara Electric Town
stops.tips: Electronics, anime and retro games. Try Yodobashi and Super Potato.

stops.name: Odaiba Seaside Park
stops.tips: Artificial island reached by the Yurikamome line. Watch sunset at Rainbow Bridge and see the giant Gundam.

backups.name: Ueno Zoo
backups.tips: Pandas. Go instead of the museum.

stops.name: Kotoku-in Great Buddha
stops.tips: One hour from Tokyo. A 13 m bronze Buddha you can step inside.

stops.name: Hase-dera
stops.tips: Temple with a hydrangea garden. Views over Kamakura's coast.

stops.name: Komachi Dori
stops.tips: Kamakura's food street. Try shirasu (baby fish) donburi.

stops.name: Yuigahama Beach
stops.tips: Kamakura's beach. Swimming and beach cafes in summer.

stops.name: Enoshima Island
stops.tips: Reach the island by Enoden train. Sunset and the silhouette of Mount Fuji.

days.theme: Tokyo Station and Imperial Palace: a gentle farewell

stops.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
stops.tips: Gardens of the former Edo castle. Free entry, closed on Mondays and Fridays.

stops.name: Tokyo Station Marunouchi
stops.tips: Red-brick station from 1914. Visit Character Street and pick up an ekiben (station bento).

stops.name: Rokurinsha Tokyo Station
stops.tips: Tsukemen on Ramen Street. A farewell lunch.

stops.name: Tokyo Character Street
stops.tips: Souvenirs. Look for Kit Kat flavours and Tokyo Banana.

stops.name: Narita Express / Keisei
stops.tips: Narita takes 1 hour, Haneda 30 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Nihonbashi Bridge
backups.tips: Japan's kilometre zero. Coredo shopping mall.
